title: Who owns the sunscreen?
answer: Whoever brought it. This makes it a shared service with no roadmap.

title: What is the dress code?
answer: Business casual, with an emphasis on casual and a minimum of one flower.

title: Will there be Wi-Fi?
answer: At the pool, the lobby, and the pond, where a small golden goose has been asked to stop sitting on the router. Coverage elsewhere is described as aspirational.

title: Do I need to open my laptop?
answer: No. Please bring it anyway, so it can feel included.

title: What should my out-of-office say?
answer: "Back Monday, fragrant." Edits are permitted, but fragrance is encouraged.
